summary: Tested Upload History modal fix after refactor with standalone={false} prop. Login → header Clock icon → modal opens with full list of previous uploads (16 entries shown with filename, date, totals, approved/review counts, user email, status). Close (X) button works. LOAD button successfully restored a previous upload and rendered the Results Table + KPI metrics on dashboard. Empty white screen bug is fixed.
passed: Login flow (admin@poreview.com) succeeds and redirects to /dashboard
History toggle button (Clock icon in header, data-testid='history-toggle-button') opens overlay modal
Upload History modal renders content (NOT empty/white) - shows 16 prior upload cards with details: filename, timestamp, total/approved/review counts, user_email, status
Each upload row shows a working LOAD button
LOAD click triggered GET /api/upload/{id}, dispatched handleLoadUpload, toast 'Upload loaded successfully!' shown, Results Table + KPIs + ActionBar rendered
GET /api/history returns data successfully (no JS errors in console)
action_items: Note (not a regression from this fix): The loaded historical upload shows €0.00 in Total/Approved PO Amount KPIs because the saved data has 0 quantities/costs — this matches user's earlier 'all zeros' screenshot but appears to be a data-quality issue from the original Excel/processing, not the history modal. Worth investigating upload processing separately if user re-reports.
